messages:
alex_support: Hey team — customer on account redwood-acme reports GitHub OAuth failing at callback with state mismatch. Starts ~15:02 UTC. They say it used to work and started after an edge worker change. Error from our auth service: "state param mismatch".

maria_cse: Customer reproduction notes: app calls /oauth/authorize -> GitHub -> redirect back to https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?code=...&state=eyJ... (state length ~ 280 chars). After redirect our endpoint logs show expected state shorter (~200 chars). They see 400 and UX stuck on "Signing you in..."

alex_support: Can you check if any proxy/edge is trimming the querystring or double-encoding? They mentioned we rolled out a Cloudflare Worker change yesterday.

sam_auth: Looking. Quick hypothesis: the worker we pushed normalizes URL and runs encodeURIComponent on full querystring which can double-encode the PKCE/state payload. If the app stores state in cookie (URL-safe base64) and we compare raw vs decoded, double-encoding will mismatch. Also some proxies truncate query strings over 200 chars.

jin_oncall: I pulled our auth logs, sample: 

```
[2025-11-24T15:02:12Z] authsvc: incoming /auth/callback?code=O0x...&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...[truncated]
[2025-11-24T15:02:12Z] authsvc: cookie state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.VERYLONG
[2025-11-24T15:02:12Z] authsvc: compare expected 200b vs received 280b -> state mismatch
```

jin_oncall: Worker traces show we rewrite URL with `encodeURIComponent(request.url.search)` at the top of the handler. That will turn `%` into `%25` etc and can increase length or change bytes. Also CF edge limits querystring length and will truncate (we saw a 200-char cutoff in older docs).

maria_cse: Customer says workaround: manually shorten state by switching to a short random nonce (they tested with custom client and it worked). But they need PKCE & payload encoded in state for cross-device flow.

sam_auth: Temporary mitigations: 1) roll back worker change that calls encodeURIComponent on the whole query. 2) if rollback not possible, change authsvc to compute and compare a digest of state (e.g., HMAC of trimmed/canonicalized value) for tolerant match for double-encoded variants. But digest requires coordinated client change if state includes PKCE payload.

alex_support: Any quick fix we can push while we investigate? Customer is high-priority (SLA).

jin_oncall: I pushed a small fix to the worker to stop touching search/query and pass through raw request.url. Deploy id: dpl-20251124-enc-fix, started at 15:20 UTC. deploy-bot: Deployed dpl-20251124-enc-fix to edge (canary 10%).

deploy-bot: ✅ canary OK (10%) — no errors. Rolling to 100% now.

sam_auth: After roll forward, I see login success for the customer at 15:24:02 in auth logs. No more truncation. I'll run a follow-up test suite against long state values and PKCE combos.

alex_support: I told the customer to try again. They reported success and thanked us. Leaving notes: root cause = Cloudflare worker double-encoding/trimming querystring -> state length mismatch. Remediation = revert encodeURIComponent and avoid rewriting search. Follow-up: eng-auth to add robust logging around state length and add a warning metric for truncated querystrings.

sam_auth: Filing follow-up ticket: ENG-AUTH-582 "tolerate/alert on altered callback querystrings (state/PKCE)" with proposed tasks: add detection, add test vectors, add flaky-canary alerts.

alex_support: Thanks all — closing thread once ticket created and customer confirmed. :thumbsup:
